timeline.message: Preprocessed 58-second video. Sampled 42 high-entropy keyframes. Detected 5 distinct application windows.
Identified Shopify Admin table, Stripe dashboard payment status, QuickBooks invoice inputs, and Google Sheets rows.
Synthesized 42 raw UI interactions into 7 clean business process nodes with dependency edges and data propagation paths.
Mapped 6 of 7 steps to direct REST APIs (Shopify Admin API, Stripe REST, QuickBooks Intuit v3, Google Sheets v4, SendGrid v3). Zero browser scraping required.
Generated complete TypeScript orchestration script and execution plan with retry policies and audit logging.
Executed end-to-end sandbox mock order #9831. Verified 6/6 step outputs. Execution duration: 1.28s. Zero errors.
Received screen recording payload for process "Order Processing & Fulfillment". Validated MP4 container.
Sampling video frames at 1 fps with scene-change entropy detection. 42 keyframes extracted.
Vision Agent scanning visual frames: detecting bounding boxes, window headers, OCR labels, and cursor coordinates.
Computer Vision analyzed 42 frames across 5 SaaS web applications. Detected 7 sequential user actions with average 97.1% visual confidence.
Process Analyst Agent translating raw interactions into business process nodes and dependency edges.
Process Analyst constructed a 7-step process graph with 6 state edges. Estimated automation feasibility is 94%, eliminating an estimated 7.5 minutes of manual labor per order.
